title: External Application Accuracy Contract Canonical Admission and Temporal-Indicator Binding Review Closeout

qualified_capability.source_identity: byte-identical Git blob to the F-GC09 qualified candidate
qualified_capability.purpose: Carry externally qualified and provenance-bound groundwater head or drawdown application requirements and temporal allocation policy, compose their native head-domain temporal budget, and materialize that budget into the pre-existing generic model-owned canonical temporal-indicator budget carrier.
qualified_capability.H_app: positive finite externally qualified and provenance-bound head-domain application prediction-accuracy requirement in cm
qualified_capability.A_temporal: positive finite independently qualified and provenance-bound allocation fraction with 0 < A_temporal <= 1

temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.initial_review_question: Whether a head/drawdown budget in cm could be safely placed in the generic canonical model_temporal_indicator_budget carrier without an explicit model-specific interpretation and normalization path.
temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.generic_carrier_semantics: The current canonical contract deliberately assigns no physical units or estimator semantics to the carrier. The selected model owns the interpretation and must normalize its native indicator into the dimensionless F-KT09 certificate surface.
temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.current_selected_model_binding: The current canonical serialized reference backend copies the generic budget into its temporal_indicator_budget and exposes it diagnostically as temporal_head_budget.
temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.native_indicator: The current canonical reference Richards temporal indicator produces head_inf_bound in the same native head domain.
temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.transaction_transfer: When finite and nonnegative, the normalized indicator is published as outcome%temporal_indicator with temporal_certificate_available=true.
temporal_indicator_binding_resolution.conclusion: The F-GC09 cm budget is explicitly and testably bound to the current canonical model-owned head temporal indicator and is normalized before transaction-certificate use. The preregistered unbound-semantics blocker does not apply to this postimage.
